Court case over AMMA ad-hoc committee functioning

A legal dispute has arisen concerning the functioning of the ad-hoc committee of AMMA, an association. Ansiba Hassan has filed a plea to be included in the ongoing court case that has placed a stay on the committee's operations. Rival factions within the association are reportedly clashing over this interim order.
